summary: The change replaces a NotImplementedError with a ConditionSet return in _solve_trig, exactly matching the issue's requested behavior and consistent with how solveset signals unsolved equations elsewhere. Clean, minimal, correct fix; ConditionSet and Eq are already imported in the module.

issues.description: Callers that previously relied on _solve_trig raising NotImplementedError (to fall through to other solving strategies) now receive a ConditionSet instead. In practice solveset treats ConditionSet as the canonical 'unsolved' result, so this is the intended pattern and low risk, but worth a sanity check that no upstream caller branches on the exception.
